name: KO_SCIENCE
description: KO_SCIENCE is a Korean-language science question dataset intended to evaluate models' factual science knowledge and short-form reasoning on school-level science problems. It covers topics such as physics, chemistry, and biology and is primarily used to test QA and exam-style question answering in Korean. The benchmark is formatted for automated scoring of model answers.
reputation: Moderately used within Korean NLP and benchmarking collections on Hugging Face, but not widely adopted internationally.
